def solution():
    # Define variables
    advertising_expenditure = [3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000]
    revenue = [20000, 23000, 25000, 26000, 28000]

    # Calculate the least squares regression slope
    mean_x = sum(advertising_expenditure) / len(advertising_expenditure)
    mean_y = sum(revenue) / len(revenue)

    numerator = sum(
        (x - mean_x) * (y - mean_y)
        for x, y in zip(advertising_expenditure, revenue)
    )
    denominator = sum(
        (x - mean_x) ** 2
        for x in advertising_expenditure
    )

    slope = numerator / denominator

    # Return the slope rounded to two decimal places
    return round(slope, 2)
